name: Dragon Blade
description: Any successful To Hit rolls in close combat with this sword are multiplied into 2 Hits.

name: Sword of Anti-Heroes
description: +1 Strength and +1 Attack for every enemy character in base contact.

name: Tormentor Sword
description: Enemy monster/character wounded gains Stupidity for rest of game.

name: Warrior Bane
description: Enemy monster/character wounded permanently loses 1 Attack per unsaved wound (min 1).

name: Trickster's Helm
description: Model on foot only. 6+ armour save. Successful To Wound rolls against wearer must be re-rolled.

name: Armour of Silvered Steel
description: Heavy armour. 2+ armour save that cannot be improved.

name: Glittering Scales
description: Light armour. -1 To Hit in close combat.

name: Bedazzling Helm
description: 6+ armour save. Enemies re-roll 6s To Hit in close combat.

name: Helm of Discord
description: 6+ armour save. At start of each Close Combat phase, choose an enemy character in base contact; they must pass a Ld test or cannot attack and is hit automatically.

name: Shield of the Warrior True
description: Shield. Ward save (5+) against missile attacks.

name: Enchanted Shield
description: Shield. +2 armour save instead of normal +1.

name: Charmed Shield
description: Shield. One use only. First hit ignored on 2+.

name: Dawnstone
description: Model on foot only. Re-roll failed armour saves.

name: Opal Amulet
description: One use only. Ward save (2+) against first unsaved wound.

name: Lucky Trinket
description: One use only. Re-roll a single failed armour or Ward save.

name: Pidgeon Plucker Pendant
description: Ward save (4+) against wounds caused in close combat by models with Fly.

name: Destroy Magic Scroll
description: One use only. 6 free dispel dice. On 4+, enemy caster loses the spell for the game.

name: Feedback Scroll
description: One use only. Spell cast as normal, then roll D6 per casting die: 5+ = 1 wound (ignores armour) to caster.

name: Sivejir's Hex Scroll
description: One use only. Spell cast as normal. Enemy wizard must roll under wizard level on D6 or characteristics reduced to 1.

name: Rod of Power
description: Save up to 3 unused power/dispel dice. Roll to recover next phase.

name: Dispel Scroll
description: One use only. 6 free dispel dice.

name: Scroll of Leeching
description: One use only. Spell cast as normal. Add dispel dice equal to casting dice used.

name: The Mystic Shield of Brag
description: One use only. Enemy spell targeting friendly unit has no effect.

name: Channelling Staff
description: +1 die when channelling power or dispel dice.

name: Mystic Maze
description: One use only. Scatter an enemy spell 3D6" in a random direction.

name: Arcane Familiar
description: Choose one Signature spell from any of the eight Lores of Battle Magic.

name: Earthing Rod
description: One use only. On miscast, do not add power dice used to result.

name: Forbidden Rod
description: One use only. +D6 power dice, bearer takes 1 wound (ignores armour).

name: Hypnotic Eye Scroll
description: One use only. Enemy wizard must pass Ld test or you choose the spell's target.

name: Power Scroll
description: One use only. Any double (except 1s) counts as 6 for Ultimate Power.

name: The Gem of Taranto
description: One use only. On successful dispel, bearer gains the spell for rest of game.

name: Luckstone
description: One use only. Re-roll all dice for a cast or dispel attempt.

name: Power Stone
description: One use only. +D3 power dice to a casting attempt.

name: Scroll of Shielding
description: One use only. Target gains Magic Resistance (3) against the spell.

name: Trickster's Shard
description: One use only. When bearer's spell is dispelled, 4+ = 1 wound on enemy wizard.

name: Wizard's Staff
description: Use one more die than normally allowed when casting.

name: Fozzrik's Folding Fortress
description: Place a watchtower in your deployment zone.

name: Wizarding Hat
description: Wearer becomes a Level 2 Wizard (random lore). Gains Stupidity.

name: Ruby Ring of Ruin
description: Bound spell (PL4). Contains Fireball from Lore of Fire.

name: Lifestone of Ashraaz
description: One use only. Swap current Wounds with enemy model in base contact.

name: Orb of Thunder
description: Bound spell (PL4). Remains in play. Models cannot use Fly.

name: Arabyan Carpet
description: Infantry on foot only. Fly (10). Cannot join units.

name: The Terrifying Mask of Eee!
description: Terror. Other models cannot use bearer's Leadership.

name: The Other Trickster's Shard
description: Bearer and all units in base contact must re-roll successful ward saves.

name: Boots of Flight
description: Model on foot only. Movement 10, Strider, Swiftstride.

name: Healing Potion
description: One use only. Recover D3 Wounds.

name: Ironcurse Icon
description: Bearer and unit gain Ward save (6+) against artillery.

name: Potion of Strength
description: One use only. +D3 Strength until end of turn.

name: Potion of Toughness
description: One use only. +D3 Toughness until end of turn.

name: Potion of Speed
description: One use only. +D3 Attacks until end of turn.

name: Potion of Foolhardiness
description: One use only. Frenzy until end of turn.

name: Warrior Familiar
description: +1 Strength 3 Attack. Does not benefit from weapons or special rules. Does not count against magic item limit.

name: Banner of Might
description: +1 To Hit in first round of close combat.
